versions.changelog: Store the token expiry as a number so setup succeeds on the current runtime
Move hosted OAuth MCP skills to setup-time vault seeding

- Switch to Atlassian Rovo's hosted MCP server as backend, replacing local stdio/mcp-atlassian setup.
- Updated authentication to use Rovo MCP's OAuth client/refresh/access tokens managed by mcporter.
- Simplified requirements: only mcporter binary needed; uvx/mcp-atlassian are no longer required.
- Documentation now emphasizes live tool catalog discovery from the hosted server; instructions updated for new workflow.
- Added troubleshooting and references for new backend.

- Migrated Confluence integration from Atlassian's hosted MCP server to the local stdio mcp-atlassian server via uvx.
- Updated required dependencies: now requires both mcporter (Node) and mcp-atlassian (uvx); added dependency on uvx binary.
- Changed environment variables for authentication to new standard: expects MAVERICK_CONFLUENCE_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN, MAVERICK_CONFLUENCE_MCP_CLOUD_ID, and MAVERICK_CONFLUENCE_MCP_CONFLUENCE_URL.
- Removed previous bash scripts and OpenAI agent integration files; all invocation flows now run through mcporter and mcp-atlassian.
- Updated usage and setup instructions reflecting new tool discovery and invocation model.
- Improved references and documentation to reflect local execution, authentication, and performance considerations.

Initial release of maverick-confluence-mcp.

- Search, read, and update Confluence pages, spaces, comments, and documentation workflows via Atlassian's hosted MCP server.
- Uses OAuth-based authentication with automatic token provisioning and rotation.
- Provides structured output and error handling through a wrapper script.
- Includes safety guidelines for write operations to Confluence content.
- Auto-installs required dependencies: mcporter, jq, flock, and shasum.
